id='content'><section class="g-py-50"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><div class='g-mt-30 g-mt-0--lg main-image g-brd-around g-brd-gray-light-v4 g-pa-2 g-mb-25'><img class='img-fluid' alt='' src='/site/assets/files/1236/cpl_matri.1140x450.jpg'></div><div class="u-heading-v2-1--bottom g-mt-30 g-mt-0--lg g-mb-30"><h1 class="u-heading-v2__title g-mb-10">All rooms at Univela</h1><div class="g-font-weight-200"><p>Single Room, Double, Triple or Family room. To get the best price please check the availability.</div></div><p>Univela offers comfortable Bed &amp; Breakfast accommodation with a rich breakfast buffet to start a day of sport or relaxation in the best possible way.<br>All rooms have a balcony, private bathroom with large shower and hairdryer, flat-screen satellite TV, comfortable Dorelan mattresses, air conditioning and internet connection.<p>Our private beach, adjacent to the structure, complete with umbrellas and sunbeds offers the opportunity to relax and immerse yourself in the fantastic panorama that the lake offers.<p>The choice can be between the single room and the double room, up to the family room for four people.<br>Some overlook the lake and others overlook the suggestive mountains.<p>Guests can include lunch and dinner in our Restaurant Pizzeria - Univela Beach where you can taste pizza, homemade pasta, fresh salads and other sea and mountain specialities, vegan or vegetarian dishes or enjoy one of the special recipes at Caffè Pascucci on the terrace lake view.<h2>Accommodation Options</h2><ul><li><h3>Single Room</h3><li><h3>Double or twin room</h3><li><h3>Triple or quadruple room</h3><li><h3>Family room</h3><li><h3>Bed in a hostel room shared by 4 or 6 beds</h3></ul><p>All private rooms can also be available with Lake View.<h2>Services included</h2><p>All the following services are free of charge for all the Univela guests. Some of the services have being temporarly suspended due to the Covid emergency regulation.<ul><li><strong>Boat storage</strong><li><strong>Hauling services with 6-ton crane</strong><li><strong>Road trolley storage</strong><li><strong>Deposit kitesurf boards</strong><li>Restaurant divided into Wet and Dry area to be able to access even with wet clothing<li>Technogym equipped gym<li>Wi-Fi in outdoor and common areas<li>Cable Internet in the rooms<li>Changing rooms with showers<li>Equipped meeting rooms<li>Coffee bar with TV<li>Parking place<li>Use of the slipway for boats<li>Video monitored dryer room for wet equipment<li>Panoramic terrace<li>Large yard accessible to vans with trailers<li>Beach and lawn with sunbeds and umbrellas available<li>Information material for sports activities, rentals, organized excursions and taxi service</ul><h2 class='g-mt-30'>Gallery</h2><div class='children gallery row g-mt-25'><div class='col-md-4 col-sm-6 g-mb-30'><a class='js-fancybox
